trace-space.note: Trace.Space (engineering requirements platform, Riga); Cherry led the $4M seed Feb 2025 (own post: the firm's first Baltic deal)

twaice.note: Battery analytics software; EUR 2M seed Jun 2019 (own post); $11M Series A Mar 2020 (own post) = graduation; $26M 2021, $30M 2022

uify.note: Uify (Berlin, 2022) now trading as turian (turian.ai, low-code enterprise apps): investors Cherry and Visionaries Club per Deutsche Startups (Wikipedia insource), $3.8M raised; job-board listing; round unnamed

unlock-protocol.note: Membership/NFT protocol (Unlock Inc, New York); Cherry seed 2018-09 (site label Seed); named in the 2019 Fund III post; $4M 2021 raise was a seed extension, no Series A

venmark.note: Venmark (venmark.co.uk, founded 2025); job-board listing only, no public record of the product or the round; sector outside the taxonomy until identified

vesper.note: AI-generated role-playing games (Amsterdam; Robert Gaal); $1.7M pre-seed Jun 2023 with Cherry and Gradient (Tracxn); Wikidata's Brazil match is a homonym (disputed)

vicomi.note: Vicomi (audience emotion analytics, Tel Aviv); Cherry angel-fund seed 2014-10 (site label Seed), listed to 2019; dark since -> unknown

voliro.note: Aerial inspection robots (ETH spin-off); Cherry led the $12M Series A Oct 2024 (own post; Wyss Zurich) and the $23M extension Jun 2025 -> Series A entry

voy.note: Voy (joinvoy.com, weight-management health service, London per the firm's page); round unnamed

watchmaster.note: Pre-owned luxury-watch marketplace; Cherry entered Jul 2015 (site date) in the round the firm's own 2016-2019 listing labels 'Series A / Series B'; insolvency filed Nov 2022 after a EUR 10M vault robbery, business broken up (LTO) -> defunct

weengs.note: Ship-from-store logistics for e-commerce; Cherry seed 2016-08 (site label Seed); GBP 6.5M Series A Apr 2019 (TechCrunch; Oxford Capital, LocalGlobe, Cherry) = graduation; ceased operations by Mar 2023 (PitchBook)

weflow.note: Revenue-AI workspace for Salesforce; $3.2M seed Jul 2023 (own post) with Cherry; $5.9M over two rounds, no Series A, 22 staff 2026

weld.note: All-in-one data platform; EUR 4M raised in its first year Nov 2021 (own post title 'raises 4.6 million', round unnamed) with Cherry; ~$7M over two rounds, no Series A, 47 staff

wunder-mobility.note: Mobility software (Wunder -> Wunder Mobility); Cherry seed 2015-06 (site date); Series A 2016 and $60M Series B 2018 (KCK) = graduation; merged with goUrban 2024, 45 staff 2026

zaro.note: Zaro.ai (AI-native enterprise workspace, London); Cherry led the $5.1M pre-seed Jun 2026 (own post; The SaaS News calls it a pre-seed)
